transferfrom_invoked.meaning: transferFrom is invoked moving tokens from an owner (from) on behalf of a spender (msg.sender)

offchain_reconstructs_from_events.meaning: off-chain tooling reconstructs senders and balances from Transfer(from,to,amount) events

event_from_address.meaning: from address recorded in the emitted Transfer event

owner_from_parameter.meaning: the from parameter, i.e. the token owner whose tokens are moved

offchain_attribution_correct.meaning: off-chain wallets/indexers correctly attribute the token movement to the actual owner rather than the spender
offchain_attribution_correct.checkpoint: after off-chain consumption of the Transfer log

assumptions: The spender's allowance/authorization to move the owner's tokens is not established by the report and is not part of the selected precondition.
The scenario is described generically without concrete addresses, amounts, or transaction identifiers.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the spender held a pre-existing allowance before calling transferFrom; the authorization condition is left out of P rather than invented.

limitations: The impact 'breaks wallets/indexers' is a downstream consequence of the wrong from-address attribution; the relation requires both the event-from/owner correspondence and correct off-chain attribution.
Only the breaks_wallets_indexers impact is formalized here; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
